Package com.github.workerframework.api

Interface WorkerFactory

All Superinterfaces:
com.github.cafapi.common.api.HealthReporter
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractWorkerFactory
public interface WorkerFactory extends com.github.cafapi.common.api.HealthReporter
Instantiates a new instance of a Worker given task-specific data. Most implementations of WorkerFactory should extend DefaultWorkerFactory.

  • Method Details

    • getWorker

      default Worker getWorker(String classifier, int version, TaskStatus status, byte[] data, byte[] context, TrackingInfo tracking) throws TaskRejectedException, InvalidTaskException
      Instantiate a new worker for given task data
      Parameters:
      classifier - the classifier indicating the type of message it is
      version - the api version of the task's message
      status - the status of the task
      data - the raw serialised task data
      context - provides access to task specific context, may be null
      tracking - additional fields used in tracking task messages
      Returns:
      a new Worker instance that will perform work upon the taskData
      Throws:
      TaskRejectedException - if a Worker cannot be created to handle this task currently
      InvalidTaskException - if it appears this task cannot possibly be handled by a Worker of this type

    • getWorker

    • getInvalidTaskQueue

      String getInvalidTaskQueue()
      Returns:

    • getWorkerThreads

      int getWorkerThreads()
      Returns:

    • shutdown

      default void shutdown()
      Perform necessary cleanup of resources that the WorkerFactory was using. After this point, the factory can assume it will no longer be called.
